subject.title: Proposal (successor to #93793): bundled Claude app-server harness extension (claude-bridge) — extended scope, maintainer decision requested

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this as a bundled Claude harness, require an external plugin/ClawHub package, or first define a narrow missing plugin-SDK contract?
rationale: The choice determines long-lived ownership of provider behavior, subprocess execution, credentials, package provenance, and the public plugin/config surface; it cannot be inferred safely from the contributor implementation alone.

options.title: External-first plugin design
options.body: Ask for a small external plugin/package design and a precise list of missing SDK seams; sponsor core changes only for demonstrated gaps.

options.title: Sponsor a bundled harness
options.body: Accept a maintained in-tree Claude extension only after assigning package provenance, auth/tool boundary ownership, and a staged review plan for the core enablers.

options.title: Prefer an existing Claude path
options.body: Decline the new harness direction and identify the supported Claude CLI, ACP, or provider workflow that should receive any targeted fixes instead.

recommendation.title: External-first plugin design
recommendation.body: Ask for a small external plugin/package design and a precise list of missing SDK seams; sponsor core changes only for demonstrated gaps.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context directly connects steipete to the renewed discussion and adjacent runtime ownership, making them the strongest visible routing candidate.
